title: Flight plan timeline, 0:00–1:30: launch, insertion, null relative velocity with booster
description: Vertical elapsed-time axis from 0:00 to 1:30 beginning with "LAUNCH" and "SECO+30 S/C SEP~5 FT/SEC", followed by insertion checklist, platform alignment, suit integrity check, "NULL REL VEL WITH BOOSTER", "GO/NO GO FOR 2-1" and "UNSTOW CAMERAS". It ends with "CLOSE WITH BOOSTER ESTABLISH FORMATION FLIGHT PROCEDURE FOR EVA PASS BASED ON BOOSTER ANGULAR RATES". Boxed tracking-station codes (CNV, BDA, CYI, KNO, TAN, CRO, CTN, GYM) and a hatched "NIGHT" bar appear at right.
